negativeCases.scenario: The delivery POST returns 200 and the run reports a completed delivery. The backend rejected the payload downstream and nothing was recorded.
negativeCases.refusedBy: nesy.remote.delivery-transport-ack declares transportSuccessOnly:true, so validateEvidenceSource refuses it a factKey and PRIMARY authority. REMOTE.DELIVERY_CONFIRMED is a correlated derivation over the backend status and the app's submission event.

negativeCases.scenario: The courier is underground. The operation queues correctly, the backend has not confirmed yet, and the run reports FAIL — making the suite unusable in normal working conditions.
negativeCases.refusedBy: REMOTE.DELIVERY_CONFIRMED is EVENTUAL with onTimeout INCONCLUSIVE, the queue wait uses onTimeout INCONCLUSIVE, and LOCAL.OFFLINE_QUEUE_ITEM_WAITING is carried as an OPTIONAL diagnostic requirement.

negativeCases.scenario: The offline queue is modelled as a fifth evidence plane, so every future local mechanism needs a Core change.
negativeCases.refusedBy: EVIDENCE_PLANES is a closed four-member union, FORBIDDEN_EVIDENCE_PLANES lists QUEUE explicitly, and the queue source is LOCAL/OFFLINE_QUEUE_WATCH.

negativeCases.scenario: Neither branch of the online/offline switch matches, the step is skipped, and the backend verification never runs — reading as success.
negativeCases.refusedBy: The SWITCH declares an explicit default GOTO to verify-backend-status; validateWorkflowIrV2 raises MISSING_SWITCH_DEFAULT when a default is absent.
